summary: MockReel environment swap verified. Env selector now shows exactly 5 options (Living Room, Bedroom, Bright Bedroom, Sunlit Bedroom, Soft Loft). Ocean, Park, Green Bokeh are gone. All 5 thumbnails load real images (naturalWidth=800, complete=true) and each produces a visually distinct blurred background behind the keyed hand (5 unique avg canvas colors sampled from top strip: LivingRoom [37,19,6], Bedroom [92,46,16], BrightBedroom [186,184,185], SunlitBedroom [47,43,35], SoftLoft [135,140,135]). Keyed hand/phone composite is intact (notch preserved, no white leftover, video inside phone display). All regression controls present: hand-zoom/panx/pany/reset, screen-left/top/width/height/reset, hook-toggle, cta-toggle, and Export MP4 button. No console errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env selector uses button:has(img[alt='<Label>']) selectors. SCREEN POSITION section is collapsed by default — must click its header before screen-reset-btn / screen-*-slider become present in DOM. Export button label is 'Export MP4' (no data-testid), Hook & CTA controls use hook-toggle/cta-toggle testids (not hook-overlay-toggle/end-card-toggle).
